title: Intersection numbers and positivity
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Intersection numbers of line bundles on proper schemes, defined through Snapper's polynomial of Euler characteristics, with multilinearity, reduction to components and divisors, degrees on curves, pullback and positivity for ample bundles; the Nakai-Moishezon criterion for ampleness; nef line bundles and Kleiman's theorem that they have nonnegative intersection numbers, so that nef plus ample is ample; and Bézout's inequality for the isolated zeros of n polynomials in n variables, with a weighted version.
prerequisites: AG-QC lessons on Euler characteristics and Hilbert polynomials, coherent direct images, and Serre's theorems
AG-MO lessons on ample and very ample sheaves, dimension of fibres, and Zariski's Main Theorem
AG-CA lessons on completion, dimension theory, and Cohen-Macaulay rings

checks.exact_checks: python/sympy: Snapper intersection numbers on P1 x P1 and on the blow-up of P2 at a point from the mixed-difference formula; chi(O(-3)) = 1 on P2; Macaulay's theorem for random systems of degrees (2,3) and (2,2,2) by Groebner bases; the Bézout examples and the deformation of Lemma 1.3 over Q(t) (scratch posit_checks.py) (8 Oct 2026)

free_sources: Vakil, The Rising Sea: Foundations of Algebraic Geometry (public draft, 21 Oct 2025)
The Stacks project, Varieties, section Numerical intersections (Tag 0BEL)
